skill.name: paper-2-web
skill.description: Convert academic papers into interactive websites, presentation videos, and conference posters using Paper2All workflow guidance.
skill.summary: Guides Paper2All workflows for research websites, video abstracts, and conference posters.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown fences, inline option names, placeholder API keys, and benign documentation prose. The real risks are a sudo system package installation step and an unpinned external Paper2All installation workflow.

remediation.suggestion: Do not instruct agents to run sudo automatically. Present system packages as manual prerequisites that require explicit user approval.
Pin Paper2All to a specific commit or release and provide dependency hashes or lock files for reproducible installation.

remediation.issue: API key handling guidance is minimal
remediation.suggestion: State that .env files must stay local, must not be printed in logs, and should use least-privilege keys where possible.

static_findings.snippet: Create a `.env` file in the project root with the following credentials:
- Verify `.env` file is in the project root
- Ensure no extra spaces or quotes around keys in `.env`
- Check that API keys are valid and have sufficient credits
3. **Backing**: Foam core or rigid backing for stability
2. **Limit text**: Use bullet points, avoid paragraphs
- Custom branding requires manual specification or API access
- `--model-choice 1`: GPT-4 (best balance of quality and cost)
- Ensure LaTeX source compiles successfully: `pdflatex main.tex`
- **`references/paper2web.md`**: Detailed Paper2Web documentation with all features
- **`references/paper2video.md`**: Comprehensive Paper2Video guide including talking-head setup
- **`references/paper2poster.md`**: Complete Paper2Poster documentation with design templates
# Optional: GOOGLE_API_KEY and GOOGLE_CSE_ID for logo search

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned External Pipeline Installation
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs users to clone the Paper2All repository and install its requirements without pinning a commit, release, or dependency hashes. Future upstream changes could run unexpected code in the local environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The clone and requirements installation steps are explicit in the setup documentation. This is a supply-chain risk, not direct evidence of malicious exfiltration.

content.user_title: Convert Papers into Web, Video, and Posters
content.value_statement: Academic teams spend time turning papers into websites, videos, and posters. This skill guides Paper2All workflows that transform LaTeX or PDF papers into dissemination assets.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup for Paper2All, Conda, LibreOffice, Poppler, and API key configuration.
Selects Paper2Web, Paper2Video, Paper2Poster, or combined workflows based on dissemination goals.
Provides input and output structure guidance for LaTeX, PDF, figures, tables, and bibliography files.
Explains website generation features, including responsive pages, interactive figures, citations, and logo discovery.
Documents poster sizing, QR code options, institution branding, print preparation, and review checklists.
Documents video generation options, including slides, narration, timing, and optional talking-head requirements.
limitations: Requires the external Paper2All project and local system dependencies before generation can run.
Needs API keys for LLM-backed generation and optional Google logo search.
Talking-head video generation requires a large NVIDIA GPU and may not work on standard laptops.
Generated websites, posters, and videos still require human review for scientific accuracy.

use_cases.title: Create a Paper Homepage
use_cases.description: Turn a published paper or preprint into an explorable website for readers and collaborators.

use_cases.title: Prepare Conference Materials
use_cases.description: Generate a poster plan and video abstract from a LaTeX or PDF paper before a conference deadline.

use_cases.title: Package Lab Dissemination
use_cases.description: Create consistent web, poster, and video assets for several papers from one research group.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Output Format
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a research paper and need help sharing it. Recommend whether I should create a website, video, poster, or all three.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Website Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through creating an interactive Paper2Web homepage from my LaTeX paper. Include input preparation and review steps.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Conference Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a conference poster and short video abstract from my paper. Include sizing, narration, and accuracy checks.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Batch Dissemination Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a batch workflow for several papers that need websites, posters, and videos. Include dependencies, outputs, and quality review.

output_examples.input: A user asks for an interactive homepage from a LaTeX research paper.
output_examples.output: A Paper2Web workflow with prerequisites, source folder checks, generation steps, and final review tasks for content and links.

output_examples.input: A student needs a poster for a 36 by 48 inch conference board.
output_examples.output: A poster plan covering section priorities, figure quality, QR code placement, print resolution, and manual review points.

output_examples.input: A lab wants video abstracts for multiple accepted papers.
output_examples.output: A batch plan that separates paper inputs, selects video options, notes GPU needs, and defines review checkpoints for narration and timing.

best_practices: Use clean LaTeX sources with all figures, tables, and bibliography files included.
Review generated claims, citations, figures, and links before publishing any output.
Pin external dependencies and keep API keys in local configuration files only.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated research claims without author review.
Do not run privileged installation commands automatically from an agent session.
Do not use low-resolution figures for posters or public research websites.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill expect?
faq.answer: It works best with LaTeX source, figures, tables, and bibliography files. It can also guide PDF-based workflows.

faq.question: Can it create only a website?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow can focus on Paper2Web without generating posters or videos.

faq.question: Does video generation require special hardware?
faq.answer: Basic video workflows need normal local tools. Talking-head generation requires a large NVIDIA GPU.

faq.question: Are API keys required?
faq.answer: LLM-backed generation requires an OpenAI or OpenRouter key. Logo discovery can require Google API credentials.

faq.question: Can it create print-ready posters?
faq.answer: Yes. The references cover poster dimensions, QR codes, institution branding, and print preparation checks.

faq.question: Does it replace scientific review?
faq.answer: No. Authors should verify all summaries, claims, figures, citations, links, and accessibility details.
